reason: LKR 0.56 a message isn't obviously cheaper than what I'd get elsewhere, and I never pay before lining up rates from three providers. I might make the free account and send the 10 test messages, but I wouldn't pay until I've compared, and most of my clients would ask why we don't just use WhatsApp.
objection: I run campaigns for several clients, and a 1,000-credit pack under one shop name doesn't fit how I work. The 0.45 rate is only for 'bigger packages' and you don't say how big, so I can't compare it properly.
would_change_my_mind: A clear agency rate card showing the per-SMS price at 10k and 50k volumes, lower than the other two quotes I have, plus separate approved sender names for each client on one account.
